fields.label: Cache-expired warning from (tokens)

fields.help: The chat matrix keeps a cell for the cost and usage tile even when the sessions fill the grid. Off, it shows only in cells the grid leaves empty.
fields.label: Always show cost in the matrix

fields.help: How much of the conversations it has read the dispatcher keeps in memory, so showing one again costs nothing until its transcript changes. Past this, the least recently viewed are dropped first; the newest is always kept, however large. At most 32 are kept whatever their size.
fields.label: Conversation cache (MB)

fields.help: The conversation in the main window. Code, tables and tool lines scale with it. 14 is the standard size.

fields.help: The replies and current step in each chat matrix tile. 13 is the standard size.
fields.label: Matrix text size (px)

fields.help: When a session is still waiting on you after the delay. Sends only 'project: reason'.

fields.label: Indent guides

fields.help: Errors are also underlined, passes bold and warnings dotted, so they read the same without telling the colours apart.
fields.label: Mark by shape as well as colour

fields.help: Your messages in the chat get a tinted band down their left edge, so they stand out from Claude's text when scrolling.
fields.label: Your prompts

fields.label: Keywords

shortcuts.what: raise or open this window (the first that is free)
send as a new background session
Queue: deliver when the current turn ends
quick phrases: pick one to put in the box
next session waiting for you: blocked ones first, then failed, then finished
allow / deny the first permission request (not while typing)
the session at that place in the list
hold to dictate into the prompt box, let go to stop (Settings > Dictation: press once to start, again to stop)
close an open menu or pop-up
session jump, project picker and quick phrases: choose, take, close

fields.help: Folders whose subfolders are your projects, one per line. New session lists them; empty, it lists only the folders sessions have run in.
fields.label: Project folders

fields.help: Adds Send As Typed to the Send button: the message is typed at the session's prompt as one line, so it counts as you typing there - it can approve what a sent message cannot, such as spending. Only from this window, only into an idle session on this machine. Can only be turned on here.
fields.label: Send As Typed

fields.help: Once a session's prompt cache has expired, the chat says so - with what the next prompt costs - when its context is at least this many tokens. 0 always says so.
fields.label: Cache-expired warning from (tokens)

fields.help: The chat matrix keeps a cell for the cost and usage tile even when the sessions fill the grid. Off, it shows only in cells the grid leaves empty.
fields.label: Always show cost in the matrix

fields.help: How much of the conversations it has read the dispatcher keeps in memory, so showing one again costs nothing until its transcript changes. Past this, the least recently viewed are dropped first; the newest is always kept, however large. At most 32 are kept whatever their size.
fields.label: Conversation cache (MB)

fields.help: The conversation in the main window. Code, tables and tool lines scale with it. 14 is the standard size.
fields.label: Chat text size (px)

fields.help: The replies and current step in each chat matrix tile. 13 is the standard size.
fields.label: Matrix text size (px)

fields.help: Pressed in the prompt box, opens the phrase list. Ctrl, Alt or Win plus a key, e.g. ctrl+space or alt+q.
fields.label: Shortcut

fields.help: One per line, in the order the list shows them. The chosen one is put into the prompt box at the cursor.
fields.label: Phrases

fields.help: For sessions started with `claude --bg` (the Send button's background options, Resume in bg, dispatch) and for the first turn of a session with context started while its parent is mid-turn. Blank uses your own Claude Code settings. Bypass modes can only be set in config.json.
fields.label: Permission mode

fields.help: e.g. opus, sonnet, or a full model id. Blank uses your default.
fields.label: Model

fields.help: A subagent to run the session as. Blank for none.
fields.label: Agent

fields.help: When a new session would get a git worktree of its own (another session is already running in that folder), say so first and offer to share the folder instead. Off: the worktree is made without asking. A warning about uncommitted files is still shown.
fields.label: Ask before making a worktree

fields.help: Claude Code keeps listing a background session that has finished until you open it in its agent view. After this many hours without activity it leaves the list here too; its conversation stays in History. 0 keeps it until you take it off with its ✕.
fields.label: Hide finished sessions after (hours)

fields.help: When a session is still waiting on you after the delay. Sends only 'project: reason'.
fields.label: Push to phone (ntfy)

fields.help: On ntfy.sh the topic name is the only secret: make it unguessable.
fields.label: ntfy topic

fields.help: Windows speech, on this machine.
fields.label: Speak aloud

fields.help: -10 slowest, 10 fastest.
fields.label: Speech rate

fields.help: Rate-limit percentages that raise an alert, once per window. Comma separated.
fields.label: Alert at (% used)

fields.help: Local speech to text; nothing leaves the machine. Needs the voice worker and a model (`imperatorium voice fetch`).
fields.label: Dictation (F9)

fields.help: hold: while F9 is held down, and stops when you let go. toggle: from one press of F9 to the next. The Dictate button always toggles.
fields.label: F9 records

fields.help: A Whisper model: large-v3-turbo, medium, small, …
fields.label: Model

fields.help: Used when no usable GPU is found.
fields.label: Model without a GPU

fields.help: A language code such as en or de.
fields.label: Language

fields.help: An input device index. Blank for the system default.
fields.label: Microphone

fields.help: Faster first dictation, at the cost of about 2 GB of VRAM held.
fields.label: Load at start

fields.help: 0 never unloads.
fields.label: Unload after idle (seconds)

fields.help: Polled over SSH. Hosts are added and removed with `imperatorium remote add|remove HOST`.
fields.label: Show remote sessions

fields.help: One per line, e.g. ctrl+alt+j. The first that is free is used.
fields.label: Hotkeys

fields.help: Projects on fixed keys, in order, one per line. Live sessions fill the rest.
fields.label: Pinned projects

fields.help: Asks the project's releases for a newer version a few minutes after start and once a day, and shows a badge by the Settings button when there is one. It looks only for releases, never previews: to try a preview build, use Check for a preview below. Nothing is installed until you press Update.
fields.label: Check for updates
